tasks.short: Use special educational strategies during instruction

steps.what: Read the child's actual learning goal and selected activity guidance in {DOCS}.
Employ special educational strategies during instruction for sensory-motor, language, cognition or memory development.
Observe actual response and adjust pacing, prompts, physical support and breaks during instruction.

tasks.design: Keep the live use of special educational techniques human, using the already selected activity guidance in {DOCS}. Test native access to that guidance first; in this case it is already directly available and no additional record, generated material or software action removes instructional work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is responding to an individual child's actual participation.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability removes the need for direct instructional support in this scoped task.
tasks.still_hard: A prompt useful moments ago may now overwhelm the child.
tasks.human_edge: Read the actual situation and change support with care and patience.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in time or instructional decision rights.

evidence.claim: Live special educational support requires situated human delivery; document access alone does not perform it.

assumptions: Boundary is employing techniques during actual instruction. This task has no separate written output beyond using the existing goal/activity card; do not invent a new class-progress record or material-writing baseline. Any actual required observation entry must be scoped separately with its own existing destination and time before assigning a saving; none is assumed or credited here.

The existing learning plan and activity guidance are already produced in ordinary planning. S1 counts reading their actual content and checking the correct child/activity. Native direct access is already available; its runtime earns no labour benefit. S2-s3 produce live instruction and adjustment, not a structured feed.
No new system, form, model or process is introduced, so ongoing incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Whether actual instructional encounters require any separate record entry
research_questions: Does the actual task contain a distinct repeated lookup or record transfer beyond the existing card?

already_counted.description: Read actual guidance, deliver instruction and adjust support

incremental.description: No new system or workflow; zero additional upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and0 upkeep gives0 net. Existing source reading is separated from live delivery; native access is already direct. No unestablished report, recording or material preparation baseline is introduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet parents about progress and support resources

steps.what: Review the child's actual progress evidence in the pupil-record category of {OTHER}.
Find current community resource details relevant to the actual family question in {DOCS}.
Meet parents or guardians to discuss progress, advise on resources and teach relevant support skills.
outputs: Discussed progress and human-agreed support actions

steps.what: Write actual agreed support actions and parent concerns in the existing pupil meeting note.
inputs: Discussed progress and human-agreed support actions

steps.what: Save the ordinary parent-meeting note in the existing pupil record.

tasks.design: Configure topic links to the existing maintained community-resource directory in {DOCS}. The teacher verifies relevance and currentness, meets the family and writes the actual existing pupil-record note in {OTHER}; no resource eligibility decision, message or new report is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated directory navigation can precede an otherwise personal support conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic links can find the maintained source without generating advice.
tasks.still_hard: Family circumstances and whether a resource is practical require discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Explain support in a way the family can use and respond to their concerns.
tasks.altitude: Less directory searching; family advice and decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native links to a maintained resource directory can reduce navigation, not decide whether a service suits a family.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual progress discussion, resource advice, skill explanation and the existing meeting note used by teaching/support staff for follow-up. It adds no new parent report, referral or message. Oral-only encounters do not acquire a fabricated note baseline.

School support staff already maintain resource name, contact, scope, source link and last-checked date as their actual directory function; this design does not transfer new research to them. S2 retains actual resource reading, currentness checks and missing/obsolete detail lookup. Teacher records actual family concerns and actions in s4, with no free transcript.

Test native directory topic links first. The30% cut on s2 removes3 provisional hours of repeated folder/page navigation; all7 substantive resource-checking hours remain. All conversation and note content/save time remains ungated and fully retained.
research_questions: Do the native links expose a resource's source and last-checked date?

already_counted.description: Progress evidence, actual resource checks, parent meeting, substantive note and save

incremental.description: Maintain directory topic links when existing entries move

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R97 gives3 gross less0.5 upkeep=2.5 net for actual directory navigation replaced. Low0 retains full lookup for an unlisted specialist resource requiring fresh investigation and avoids adding this topic-link upkeep. No live advice time is cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Modify kindergarten curriculum for students with disabilities

steps.what: Read the actual general kindergarten curriculum and relevant functional access needs.
outputs: Selected objectives and actual access context

steps.what: Decide curriculum changes, retained objectives and suitable learning activities for the students.
inputs: Selected objectives and actual access context
outputs: Teacher-decided curriculum adaptations and nonidentifying drafting brief

steps.what: Format the chosen curriculum content using native accessible document styles in {DOCS}.
inputs: Teacher-decided curriculum adaptations and nonidentifying drafting brief

steps.what: Write adapted curriculum wording and activities from the teacher's selected objectives and constraints.
inputs: Teacher-decided curriculum adaptations and nonidentifying drafting brief

loop.purpose: Draft adapted wording for teacher-chosen objectives
loop.input: Fixed curriculum excerpts and nonidentifying functional constraints selected in s1-s2
loop.output: Draft wording and activity variants with objective references
loop.check: Teacher verifies retained meaning, actual accessibility, developmental suitability and objective alignment in s5
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; missing goal, unsafe activity or unmet access need returns to manual authoring within retained writing/review time
loop.why_not_simpler: Native styles handle layout in s3; rewriting varied instructional prose under supplied constraints needs a bounded language step.

steps.what: Check and repair curriculum meaning, access, objective coverage and practical suitability for actual students.
inputs: Selected objectives and actual access context

steps.what: Save the ordinary authored curriculum adaptation in the existing teaching file.

tasks.design: Test native accessible styles in {DOCS} before a bounded drafting step rewrites supplied curriculum passages against teacher-selected objectives and functional constraints. The teacher decides the modifications and verifies every activity's meaning and access; actual pupil identities and diagnostic records are excluded from the drafting brief.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mechanical layout and adapted prose composition are mixed with pedagogical decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document styles handle structure; bounded rewriting can offer a first wording for a teacher's actual choice.
tasks.still_hard: Readable text may still be inaccessible to a particular child or change the learning objective.
tasks.human_edge: Know whether this activity helps this child learn rather than merely making the page easier to read.

ambition.what: Offer a second activity variant for the same objective when a motor-access barrier prevents the first.

tasks.altitude: Less layout and first-draft typing; more checking that curriculum changes preserve meaningful learning. Instructional decisions remain the teacher's.

reach.task: Compare access variants for one curriculum objective

evidence.claim: Native styles and bounded rewriting can assist curriculum drafting without determining a pupil's educational level or learning outcome.

assumptions: Boundary is actual curriculum modification, not pupil assessment, grading, disability diagnosis or live instruction. No new progress record is created. Shares are provisional work estimates, not results from this organisation.

The existing curriculum owner produces objective codes and original content in normal planning. Teacher reads actual access requirements in s1 and authors the exact nonidentifying constraints in s2; this preparation is counted. S4-s5 retain missing-content writing, failed formatting repair and semantic/access checks; no free structured pupil profile is assumed.

Test native accessible styles first. S3 removes15 hours of actual repeated layout assembly where styles work; s4 removes10 initial wording hours while15 writing/review hours remain, plus all19 full checks. Neither step cuts pedagogical choices. Ordinary internal saving has no approval or runtime benefit.
unknowns: Actual curriculum layout and wording workload
research_questions: Does the draft preserve the learning objective while actually reducing the identified access barrier?

already_counted.description: Source reading, teacher adaptations and brief, substantive drafting correction, access/meaning checks and save

incremental.description: Maintain accessible styles and sample objective-preservation failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gives25 gross less2 upkeep=23 net. Low13 retains all25 wording hours for highly individual communication needs where generated prose is unusable; compatible accessible styles still remove15 layout hours less2 upkeep. Style-incompatible tactile materials would retain layout too and need separate scoping.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer to resolve behavioral or academic problems

steps.what: Review actual student problem evidence and relevant support agreements in the pupil system in {OTHER}.
inputs: Existing pupil evidence and support agreements

steps.what: Confer with parents, guardians, teachers, counselors or administrators to resolve behavioral or academic problems.
outputs: Human-agreed support actions and unresolved issues

steps.what: Write agreed support actions, responsible contacts and uncertainties in the existing pupil support record.
inputs: Human-agreed support actions and unresolved issues

steps.what: Save the ordinary support-action update in the existing pupil record.
outputs: Stored support actions for actual follow-up

tasks.design: Configure a direct native link to the current support record in the pupil-system category of {OTHER}. The teacher retains substantive source review, the conference and writing the actual agreed support actions; no diagnosis, behavior score or generated family message is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The current support record can take several screens to reach before a discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-record links remove only that navigation.
tasks.still_hard: People may disagree about causes, feasible support or what occurred.
tasks.human_edge: Build a workable agreement across different accounts while keeping the child's interests central.
tasks.altitude: No new decision rights; slightly less navigation before the same human discussion.

evidence.claim: Native current-record access can reduce navigation but cannot resolve a student's behavioral or academic problem.

assumptions: Boundary includes the conference and its actual support-action record used by the teaching team to carry out agreed help. No separate progress register, transcript or after-meeting report is added. A wholly oral ad hoc exchange does not acquire a new written baseline.

Existing teaching/support staff produce dated observations and prior support actions in their ordinary pupil records. S1 counts substantive reading and missing-context clarification; s2 produces actual agreement, captured manually in s3. There is no free structured meeting output.

Test native current-record access first. The5% cut on s1 removes1 provisional hour of screen navigation only, leaving19 for actual evidence review. All conference, note content and small ungated save time stays. No routine external send occurs in this design.
research_questions: Can a native current-record link remove real navigation while preserving access restrictions?

already_counted.description: Substantive evidence review, conference, actual support actions and ordinary save

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R99 gives1 gross less0.2 upkeep=0.8 net. Low0 retains full review where the right record is already one click away or context must be gathered manually, with no new link upkeep. Conversation and existing record writing are fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce actual curriculum layout and source-navigation chores while retaining direct instruction, family relationships and special educational judgement.
reach: Compare curriculum access variants with an instructional coordinator
skills_to_grow: Current resource and pupil-record source checks
role.ambitious_version: A teacher able to test an additional accessible activity variant, with personal responsibility for its suitability and the child's actual learning experience.
